# model.name

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.1.0</span></div>

Get / Set the model name.

```lua
local name = model.name([name])
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | optional |  |

## Returns

name (string)

## Examples

```lua
local name = model.name()                         -- current model's name
local safe = name:gsub("[^%w_-]", "_")            -- safe for file names
local logFile = "LOGS:/mytool/" .. safe .. ".csv"
```
